value.rationale: Normalized uniform sampling on the boundary of a regular simplex is a canonical alternative to solid-volume least squares and arises naturally from boundary-only observations. Its singular support changes Gram normalization and creates an atom in the coordinate marginal. The result supplies sharp norm, positivity defect, unique norming-location class, universal strict stability improvement and a nonvanishing 2/e asymptotic gap, making a motivated structural comparison across all dimensions.
